# filepicker

```go
import "github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/component/filepicker"
```

Package filepicker browses directories inside a pane: directories first, sizes and permissions in columns, enter to pick a file, ← to climb and from a drive's root on to the other drives. overlay.FilePicker is built on it.

<a name="Chosen"></a>
## type [Chosen](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/blob/main/component/filepicker/events.go#L5>)

Chosen is the event of an entry picked: enter, or a click on the entry already under the cursor. Path is absolute.

```go
type Chosen struct{ Path string }
```

<a name="Keys"></a>
## type [Keys](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/blob/main/component/filepicker/filepicker.go#L28-L31>)

Keys are the bindings the picker answers to. Pick shares enter with Open: on a directory it opens it, unless WithDirs.

```go
type Keys struct {
    Up, Down, PageUp, PageDown, Top, Bottom key.Binding
    Back, Open, Pick                        key.Binding
}
```

<a name="DefaultKeys"></a>
### func [DefaultKeys](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/blob/main/component/filepicker/filepicker.go#L35>)

```go
func DefaultKeys() Keys
```

DefaultKeys are the arrows, pgup/pgdown, home/end, backspace to go up and enter to pick.

<a name="VimKeys"></a>
### func [VimKeys](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/blob/main/component/filepicker/filepicker.go#L51>)

```go
func VimKeys() Keys
```

VimKeys are DefaultKeys with vim's letters added: k/j to move, K/J to page, g/G to the ends, h to go up and l to open.

<a name="Styles"></a>
## type [Styles](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/blob/main/component/filepicker/filepicker.go#L62-L69>)

Styles are how the rows are painted.

```go
type Styles struct {
    Cursor   lipgloss.Style // the row under the cursor, after its mark
    Mark     lipgloss.Style // the ">" before it
    Dir      lipgloss.Style // directories and links
    File     lipgloss.Style
    Disabled lipgloss.Style // a file of a type that cannot be picked
    Meta     lipgloss.Style // the size and permission columns, and notes
}
```

DefaultStyles ink directories and the cursor in the accent and the columns muted.
